# netactuate_secret_list_values (Data Source)

Reads Secret List Values visible to the account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netactuate_secret_list_values" "example" {
  secret_list_id = 12345
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `secret_list_id` (Number) Secret list ID whose values will be listed

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `values` (List of Object) List of values in the secret list (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--values))

<a id="nestedatt--values"></a>
### Nested Schema for `values`

Read-Only:

- `id` (Number)
- `secret_key` (String)
- `secret_list_id` (Number)
- `secret_value` (String)
